core.title: PDQ TJ Series Communicating Lever, PDQ TJ125CHI

text.description_html:
PDQ TJ Series Chicago Communicating Lever with Round Rosette

The PDQ TJ Series Communicating Lever is designed to compliment MR Series Mortise locks sharing the same sectional rose diameter and levers. It features the Chicago style lever on one side and blank plate on the other.

Features and Specifications of the PDQ TJ Series Chicago Lever:

  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Non Handed
  • Rose Diameter: 2-3/8”
  • Door Thickness: 1-3⁄8” (35mm) to 1-3⁄4” (44mm) thick
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Latch Bolt: 2-3/4” backset has 1-1/8” faceplate. 2-3/8” backset has a 1” faceplate filler

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
